item.title: Anita Krishnan
item.description: I’ve raised funding, failed at a startup, succeeded at another, and mentored dozens of founders. But my most rewarding work? Watching a 12-year-old pitch a lemonade stand idea with more conviction than most MBA graduates.

item.title: Dev Utkarsh
item.description: My first guitar was a ₹1500 instrument I bought from a local music shop when I was 12. I taught myself to play by watching YouTube tutorials and practicing for hours in my bedroom. By the time I was 18, I was playing in bands and performing at local venues.

item.title: Guitar Basics for Kids
item.description:
What You’ll Learn

  • Week 1-2: Basic chord shapes (C, G, Am, Em) and finger positioning
  • Week 3-4: Strumming patterns for popular songs
  • Week 5-6: Reading simple tablature and playing melodies
  • Week 7-8: Performing your first complete song!

What Makes This Special

This isn’t a music class where kids sit in rows and follow a textbook. We learn by playing songs kids already love — Bollywood hits, nursery rhymes, and even anime themes. Every session ends with a mini jam session where kids play together.

item.title: Prestige Lakeside Habitat
item.description: Prestige Lakeside Habitat was one of the first communities to adopt Unskooling. With an active RWA and a beautiful clubhouse, sessions here run every weekend.

item.title: Priya Sharma
item.description: I believe music isn’t about perfection — it’s about expression. When I teach kids, I don’t start with scales and theory. I start with a song they love. Once they hear themselves playing something familiar, the magic clicks.

item.title: Rahul Menon
item.description: Water is my second home, and I want every child to feel that same comfort. Too many kids in apartments grow up afraid of water — that doesn’t have to be the case when there’s a pool 50 meters from their front door.

item.title: Sai Silicon City
item.description: Sai Silicon City’s great swimming pool and community hall make it a great location for diverse learning sessions.

item.title: Sobha Dream Acres
item.description: With one of the largest resident populations in East Bangalore, Sobha Dream Acres is gearing up to launch its first Unskooling sessions.

item.title: Swimming for Beginners
item.description:
What You’ll Learn

  • Month 1: Water safety, floating, and building water confidence
  • Month 2: Freestyle stroke technique and breathing
  • Month 3: Backstroke fundamentals and treading water

Why Community Pool Learning Works

Kids learn best when they’re comfortable. Your society pool is a familiar, safe environment — no intimidating Olympic-sized pools, no strangers. Just neighbors learning together with a qualified coach who lives in your building.

item.title: Young Entrepreneurs Club
item.description:
What You’ll Learn

  • Week 1: Spotting problems worth solving — the entrepreneur’s eye
  • Week 2: Brainstorming and idea validation with real feedback
  • Week 3: Building a simple business model canvas
  • Week 4: Branding, pricing, and marketing basics
  • Week 5: Building a prototype or MVP
  • Week 6: Pitch Day — present to “investors” (parents & neighbors!)

The Grand Finale

The course culminates in a weekend pop-up shop right in the society’s common area. Kids set up real stalls, sell real products or services, and handle real money. Past ventures include a handmade bookmarks stall, a lemonade stand, and a “Tech Help Desk” for grandparents!
